derivation_rule: For a given year Y: a member with accession_date <= Y-01-01 and (exit_date is null or exit_date > Y-12-31) is a full-year member, contributing its December _YR row (raw/<snapshot_id>/partner_totals/<flow>_<Y>-12.json). A member whose accession_date or exit_date falls within year Y is a transition member for that year, contributing only its member months via _MO rows (raw/<snapshot_id>/eu_members/<flow>_<cty_code>_<YYYY-MM>.json), summed month by month. A member with accession_date after Y-12-31 or exit_date <= Y-01-01 is not a member in year Y and contributes nothing. Applying this rule to the accession/exit dates above for years 2013 and 2020 reproduces exactly the transition_years entries listed.
